title: Book Three · Chapter 134: The Story He Chooses
story:
The rest of the summer holiday passes. In the first week of the autumn term, Ronan's class writes about work.

The teacher asks for one real example. It can come from home, a visit, or a holiday job.

Ronan starts with the shelves at Mr Sun's. He writes three lines about the paper piles. Then he stops.

He remembers the woman with the cups. The biggest cup had a wide handle. Without that size, the shelf could be too narrow.

He turns his page over and starts with her drawing.

Kai looks across from his desk.

“The measuring tape?”

“Another story.”

“The pencil with experience?”

Ronan smiles. “The cups.”

He writes the woman's first words, then his question about the largest cup. He adds the empty space for the depth.

Near the end of the lesson, the teacher asks him to read the short piece.

Ronan stands beside his desk. He reads the drawing part, then looks up to explain the handle with his hands.

A boy at the back asks about the shelf.

“Did you make it?”

“Mr Sun made it. I helped find the size.”

“That was your job?”

“Part of it. Paper too. And two wrong labels.”

“Did the people get the wrong things?” the boy asks.

“No. We checked before anything left.”

Ronan puts his own page on the desk. He can feel the other students waiting for the rest.

“I put the same wrong length on two labels. Dad asked me where I started on the tape.”

“And you didn't like the paper part?”

“Not then.”

Kai looks up from his own book.

“You liked the short pencil.”

“It never answered a question for me.”

Several students laugh. Ronan looks at his page again. He has written down a successful question. He has not written about the first day, when he put all the drawings in a separate pile.

“The paper helped me later,” he says. “I could find the right drawing.”

He touches the line about the cup. The woman could tell him about her kitchen. Mr Sun could tell him about the wood. He needed space for both answers on the page.

A few students laugh. Ronan explains the folded tape. This time, he can laugh about the first forty-one as well.

The teacher brings them back to the page.

“Your question changed the work,” she says. “Keep that part clear.”

Ronan sits and adds one short line about the cup itself. He leaves out a long list of jobs from the back of the page.

After the lesson, Anna asks to read it. She sits beside him while Kai finds his lunch.

“You liked this part,” she says.

“Finding the cup size?”

“Talking to her. Finding out.”

He looks at his first three lines on the other side.

“Yes. I think I did.”

Anna gives him the page back. She has her own example about the fruit shop and its half-closed shutter.

They exchange pages for a few minutes. Ronan follows her description from the dark roof to the baskets below.

“More fruit,” he says.

She laughs. “The owner would agree.”

At lunch, Kai asks how much the four weeks paid.

“Twenty-four yuan. Twenty-three left after the peanuts.”

“You bought work food already.”

Ronan opens his lunch box. “This food came from home.”

Kai looks at it, and Ronan moves the box a little closer so they can both reach the small pickled vegetables.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

example＝例子；description＝描述；exchange＝交换；pickled＝腌制的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么换掉最初的整理纸张清单、改写杯子的故事？
2. 他怎样说清自己与Mr Sun各做了什么？这时工资是否又增加了？

## 读句子

**He turns his page over and starts with her drawing.**

拆开看：He / turns his page over / and starts / with her drawing.

他／把自己那页纸翻过来／开始写／以女顾客的图画为起点。
